name: Christoph Meier
bio:
Christoph's journey into the world of motorsport finance began unconventionally, through a passion for precision watchmaking in his native Switzerland. He quickly recognized the parallels between the intricate financial models needed to manage a successful watchmaking business and the complex budgets of a racing team. He honed his skills working with several smaller motorsport teams before landing a pivotal role at Team WRT.

His approach is meticulous and detail-oriented, viewing every financial decision as a critical component of the team's overall performance. Christoph is particularly adept at identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance, a skill highly valued within the team. What sets him apart is his ability to explain complex financial concepts in a way that engineers and drivers can easily understand, fostering a collaborative and transparent environment.

 Christoph firmly believes a team's financial health is as important as its mechanical one. He is committed to supporting Team WRT's financial stability and growth, ensuring that the team has the resources needed to compete at the highest level for years to come.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Christoph is of average height, with a focused expression and a slightly receding hairline.

quirks: Always color-codes his spreadsheets using a custom system only he understands.
Drinks copious amounts of herbal tea throughout the day.
Has a small collection of vintage stopwatches on his desk.
